Sparkling Tones, part four: the editor.
Open a preset's card and tap "Tweak". The preset goes to the amp, and the editor opens.
Drag a knob up or down. The amp follows while you play, so you hear every change.
The strip at the top is your signal chain. Tap a block, and its knobs come up.
Tap the model's name to swap it: a different drive, a different amp, anything the Spark has.
Nothing is stored until you decide. When you like it, tap "Save".
There's a second look, too. In Settings, set the editor to Neon.
Same preset, same knobs, drawn as real pedals and amps. Pick the one you prefer.
Sparkling Tones: free, and it works offline. Next: live view and banks.
